All effects

Ripple lens

Concentric rings travel out from one point and push the picture along them, like looking down through disturbed water. Rings fade with distance.

Cost
Two texture reads per pixel. Animated at 30 fps it is light, but it is still a full-screen loop: pause it off screen (the runtime does).
Fallback
No WebGL: the CSS gradient. Reduced motion: one still frame of the rings.
Becomes slop when
Used as a cursor toy on a page about something else, or with strong rings behind text.
